thread:
Samir: Quick handoff — I'll be OOO after 21:30 UTC. Leaving a short watchlist and a couple of checks to run if anything flares up. :wave:

Samir: Watchlist (non-incident):
- KV-store (prod-eu): intermittent rate-limit spikes, alert flaps but no steady degradation. Seen ~2x bursts in last 6h.
- prefetch-cache (all regions): eviction thrash => tail latency jitter on short requests.
- encoder-pool autoscaler (us-west): one node stuck in backoff, manual restart temporarily fixed it earlier.
- embedding-worker-2 (staging->canary run): sporadic OOMs during long context runs.
- telemetry sampler: sampling drop ~5% on internal traces, affects traces for reruns.

Samir: Immediate checks if alerted: 
- KV quick check: `curl -sS https://kv-prod-eu.internal/health || kubectl get pods -n kv -o wide`
- Prefetch cache metric: grafana link (p95/p99 cache eviction rate) — look for >200 evictions/min.
- Autoscaler: `kubectl describe hpa encoder-pool -n inference` and `kubectl get pods -l app=encoder -n inference`
- Embedding OOM logs: `kubectl logs embedding-worker-2 -n inference --since=1h | grep -i oom`

Marta: noted, will keep eye on kv spikes. If it flaps >3 times in 10m I'll mute noisy alert and open a ticket. :+1:

Jess: FYI — I pushed a small tweak to the kube probe for encoder-pool (shorter timeout). Rolling in us-west; should reduce the backoff loops. Watching rollout status now.

Devon: I can own the embedding-worker canary tonight. If it OOMs again I'll increase JVM heap + restart, and notify runtime team.

Samir: thanks. Also: if you see large error% on streaming (< 0.5s success drop to 0.4) please escalate to eng-runtime and attach traces. Samir is adding temporary alerts: `alert: StreamingErrorSpike` with 15m window.

deploy-bot: deploy "encoder-probe-fix" to us-west succeeded at 2026-03-17T19:12:08Z :white_check_mark:

Marta: quick note — prefCache eviction thrash looks related to a new traffic pattern from the recommendation service (more short prefixes). I've bumped cache memory on canary to 10% to test.

Jess: good call. If bump helps, let's schedule a small scale change for prod during low traffic window (02:00 UTC).

Devon: embedding-worker OOM trace shows growth on long snacks context. I'll try increasing max tokens limit for canary and see.

Samir: handoff items:
- Coverage: Marta (night), Devon (embedding canary), Jess (infrastructure / autoscaler watch).
- Escalation path: pager -> eng-oncall -> eng-runtime -> infra lead.
- Leave notes in oncall doc: /docs/oncall/2026-03-17-evening (added).

Marta: I added short checklist to the doc and a link to the grafana panels.

Jess: ping me @jess if you need me to jump in with cluster side changes.

Devon: will post results of embedding canary tests here.

Samir: thanks team — I'll be offline but reachable by SMS for urgent blips. Please @mention me for anything > P2. :eyes:

Devon: quick update (15m later) — increased canary heap, ran 200 long-context requests, no OOMs. Posting logs snippet: 
```
2026-03-17T19:28:10Z embedding-worker-2 INFO processing request id=xx duration=1.2s
2026-03-17T19:28:11Z embedding-worker-2 INFO mem_usage=3.1GB max_heap=4.0GB
```

Marta: prefCache canary bump reduced eviction rate from ~260/min to ~40/min. Leaving it bumped through the evening.

Jess: autoscaler HPA observed 2 scale events, stable since probe tweak.

Samir: excellent. If anything changes, update this thread instead of starting a new one so handoff copy stays compact.

Devon: will do. :slightly_smiling_face:

Samir: signing off — gl hf.
